description: Architectural principles for data audit pattern evaluation

principles.name: Lakehouse as Source of Truth
principles.description: All applications should store and retrieve data from the lakehouse. The lakehouse is the canonical, governed data layer.

negative: local database as source of truth

principles.name: No Application-to-Application Data Dependencies
principles.description: Applications should not depend directly on other applications for data. All data flows should go through the lakehouse or an integration layer.

negative: direct API calls between applications for data

principles.name: Enterprise SaaS via Direct API
principles.description: Enterprise SaaS platforms (Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) should be accessed via their native APIs unless there is a documented business case for routing through analytics/AI layers.
